bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears, riding a four-game winning streak, are gearing up for their Week 11 matchup against the New Orleans Saints at Soldier Field, with defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons saying his knee injury is a non-issue and expecting to play despite limited practice participation. The team also made roster moves ahead of the game, elevating running back Salvon Ahmed from the practice squad while welcoming back Kyle Monangai, who missed five games with turf toe and a thumb injury.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The biggest Lions story today centers on their Week 11 matchup against the Buccaneers at Ford Field, where Detroit entered 7-2 riding a five-game winning streak and jumped ahead early as quarterback Jared Goff fired a pass over the middle and found Amon-Ra St. Brown for a 14-yard touchdown score .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers are preparing for a Thanksgiving Eve showdown at the Los Angeles Rams, with coach Matt LaFleur saying running back Josh Jacobs needs major progress to play against the Rams as he works back from finger surgery , while quarterback Jordan Love also gave an encouraging update on Micah Parsons' potential return. Adding to the roster shuffle, the Packers re-signed running back Pierre Strong to their practice squad after previously cutting him , as Green Bay tries to build momentum after taking a 6-4 record out of their bye week and into this pivotal matchup.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Vikings received word that a reunion with recently released quarterback Daniel Jones is unlikely, as Kirk Cousins has solidified his hold on the starting job after returning via trade and leading Minnesota to a strong win over Green Bay. The team continues preparing for its Week 11 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers in Mexico City, with coaches and players adjusting to the altitude while also managing injury updates involving Jordan Addison and Donovan Jackson.
